description: Default evidence weights. Hand-set, informed by the Noordin benchmark (results/noordin) and the GAStech feasibility check; not copied from any trained model.

EMAILED.source: observed record; strength = log1p(direct emails); broadcast-only pairs get broadcast_email_weight

INTERCEPTED_COMMUNICATION.source: observed record; input weight = intercept count

FRIENDSHIP.source: Noordin: strong tier (87% of pairs also communicate; bootstrap range excludes zero)

SOULMATES.source: Noordin: high share but 11 pairs; range includes zero

BUSINESS&FINANCE.source: Noordin: high share but 15 pairs; range includes zero

private_day.source: repetition is the core lead signal (judgement); Noordin: meetings are a strong tier

home_visit.source: visit to a home is more personal than a shared venue (judgement)

after_hours_share.source: share of private overlaps after 20:00, before 06:00 or at weekends (judgement)

beats_chance.source: chance_p_value <= 0.1 with >= 2 private days: more than routine overlap

public_events_log.source: GAStech: public sightings barely change email rate (29% vs 24%)

co_resident.source: neighbours / co-residents: proximity, not a meeting

group_gathering_share.source: multiplicative: private-day points reduced by 60% x share of overlaps that were group gatherings (3+ cars)

same_department.source: GAStech: emails follow departments (95% vs 5%); same-department contact is routine

daytime_only.source: multiplicative: no after-hours overlap and no home visit -> total halved (ordinary daytime routine)

broadcast_email_weight.source: pairs linked only by all-staff broadcasts (>=10 recipients) are not a relationship; GAStech: broadcasts connect almost every pair
